functions.brief: When an allied Doll dodges, they have a chance to activate [Footwork], greatly increasing Attack Speed.
functions.detail: When an allied Doll dodges, they have a 30% chance to activate [Footwork], increasing Attack Speed by 14% for 8 seconds, cooldown 12 seconds.

functions.name: Butterfly - XX
functions.brief: When allied Dolls casts Skill, they deal Operand Damage to the closest enemy.
functions.detail: When allied Dolls casts Skill, they deal Operand Damage equal to 40% Hashrate to the closest enemy.

functions.name: Chaotic Break
functions.brief: After casting Ultimate, continually deal Physical Damage that can crit to enemies within a 2-tile radius.
functions.detail: After casting Ultimate, deal 3 instances of Physical Damage that can crit equal to 30% ATK to enemies within a 2 tile radius every second for 3 seconds.

functions.name: Death Spiral
functions.brief: After casting Ultimate, releases a bolt of Entropized lightning, bouncing between enemies and dealing Operand Damage that can crit.
functions.detail: After casting Ultimate, releases a bolt of Entropized lightning, bouncing between enemies 3 times and dealing Operand Damage that can crit equal to 80% Hashrate.

functions.name: Greed of the Ruleless
functions.brief: Every few seconds, allies lose a portion of their current health and gain Ultimate Charge.
functions.detail: Every 2 seconds, allies lose 4% current health and gain 4% Ultimate Charge.

functions.name: Malice Unleashed
functions.brief: Ultimate damage is increased; After each Ultimate cast, Ultimate damage is further increased.
functions.detail: Ultimate damage is increased by 3% ; After each Ultimate cast, Ultimate damage is further increased by 3%, max 4 stacks.

functions.name: Darkreef Current
functions.brief: After teleporting, gain stats; Generate a geyser tile below self, can trigger only once every few seconds.\nGeyser Tile: When an allied is on a Geyser Tile, they will continually absorb energy, gaining stat bonuses; When an enemy crosses over, they are knocked into the air and take damage, after which the tile disappears.
functions.detail: After teleporting, gain 10% ATK and Hashrate; Generate a geyser tile below self, can trigger only once every 5 seconds.\nGeyser Tile: When an allied is on a Geyser Tile, they will continually absorb energy, gaining 5% increase to damage dealt and Damage Reduction every 2 seconds. Once energy has been absorbed 10 times, the tile disappears; When an enemy crosses over, they are knocked into the air and receive damage equal to 10% current HP, after which the tile disappears.

functions.name: Deplorable Divinity
functions.brief: Normal Attacks apply [Curse] to targets.
functions.detail: Normal Attacks apply [Curse] to targets.\n[Curse]: Take 10% * no. of stacks more damage from Normal Attacks, max 5 stacks.

functions.name: Calamity Crystal
functions.brief: After dealing critical damage, gain Crit Damage.
functions.detail: After dealing critical damage, gain 20% Crit Damage for 5 seconds, max 5 stacks.

functions.name: Life-saving Service
functions.brief: When an ally dies, all Dolls gain 15% Life Steal for 6 seconds
functions.detail: When an ally dies, all Dolls gain 15% Life Steal for 6 seconds

functions.name: Emergency Defense
functions.brief: When an ally dies, all Dolls gain a <Color=#44b164>Shield</color>
functions.detail: When an ally dies, all Dolls gain a <Color=#44b164>Shield equal to 20% of their HP</color>

functions.name: Last Gasp
functions.brief: When a Doll dies, they deal <Color=#b99534>True Damage</color> to enemies in a 1 tile radius
functions.detail: When a Doll dies, they deal <Color=#b99534>True Damage equal to 500% of their ATK</color> to enemies in a 1 tile radius

functions.name: Multithread Aid Shots
functions.brief: When a Doll dies, ranged units gain 5 seconds of Splitshot, and melee units gain 5 seconds of Double Strike
functions.detail: When a Doll dies, ranged units gain 5 seconds of Splitshot, and melee units gain 5 seconds of Double Strike
